paper.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Wafer Bin Map Defect Pattern Classification

author_implementation.scope: adaptation of five augmentation operators to existing F, not reproduction of whole-wafer supervised classification or fine-tuning

interpretation: Crop strongest across most regimes; rotation strongest ResNet18 at1% and10% labels; paper aggregate recommendation does not imply everycrop row wins; TableII supervised finetuning median10trials not directly comparable to current retrieval. Author classification training also applies configured augmentation, so those values do not isolate the effect of self-supervised augmentation alone.
